'''Camp Vigil''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and interrogation facility located deep beneath the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Accessible via the [[Imperial Headquarters (Balmorra)|Imperial Headquarters]], Camp Vigil was destroyed by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Akaavi Spar]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberation]] of Balmorra after she and a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] failed to rescue her clanmate.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
